newsitem.title: CHINA: Share yields of Shenzhen-listed firms up in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Share yields of Shenzhen-listed firms up in 1996.

text.p: Companies listed on the Shenzhen stock exchange overall registered an improvement in performance last year, with per share yields up over 1995, the official Xinhua News Agency reported on Wednesday.
The average per share yield of the 265 companies that had reported results up to Tuesday rose 26.4 percent to 0.316 yuan from 1995, the agency said, quoting the Shenzhen Stock Exchange.
Shenzhen has a total of 281 companies listed.
Some 94 of the companies that have reported results had an average per share yield of 0.40 yuan or more, up from 68 in 1995, the exchange said.
"Blue chips maintained strong growth last year, and newly listed companies injected some new life into the stock market with promising performances," it said.
